participant_id.Description: Unique BIDS participant identifier. Encodes the ISRUC subgroup (I, II, III) and the original subject number.

index.Description: Zero-based index of the participant within its own subgroup; the counter restarts at 0 for each subgroup (I: 0-99, II: 0-7, III: 0-9).

Subject.Description: Subject identifier exactly as listed in the source Details spreadsheet. For subgroups I and III this is the plain subject number; for subgroup II it retains the source recording suffix (for example, '1_Rec.1').

age_det.Description: Age in years exactly as reported in the source ISRUC Details spreadsheet, kept verbatim as free text. '?' denotes an age that is unknown/unreported in the source; see the BIDS-standard numeric 'age' column for the derived numeric value.

Sex.Description: Sex as reported in the source ISRUC Details spreadsheet.

Diagnosis.Description: Primary clinical diagnosis of the participant, transcribed from the source Details spreadsheet (free text, original language preserved).

Other problems.Description: Additional clinical problems or comorbidities reported in the source Details spreadsheet (free text).

Epoches.Description: Number of 30-second epochs scored for the recording.

W%.Description: Percentage of epochs scored as Wake (W) by the first expert scorer.

N1%.Description: Percentage of epochs scored as stage N1 by the first expert scorer.

N2%.Description: Percentage of epochs scored as stage N2 by the first expert scorer.

N3%.Description: Percentage of epochs scored as stage N3 by the first expert scorer.

REM%.Description: Percentage of epochs scored as REM by the first expert scorer.

Date of recording.Description: Date of the PSG recording as reported in the source Details spreadsheet (date format not standardized in the source).

W%.1.Description: Percentage of epochs scored as Wake (W) by the second expert scorer.

N1%.1.Description: Percentage of epochs scored as stage N1 by the second expert scorer.

N2%.1.Description: Percentage of epochs scored as stage N2 by the second expert scorer.

N3%.1.Description: Percentage of epochs scored as stage N3 by the second expert scorer.

REM%.1.Description: Percentage of epochs scored as REM by the second expert scorer.

Medication.Description: Medication taken by the participant, transcribed from the source Details spreadsheet (free text).

EEG alterations.Description: Notable EEG alterations reported in the source Details spreadsheet (free text).

Cohen’s kappa.Description: Cohen's kappa inter-scorer agreement between the two expert scorers, as reported in the source Details spreadsheet. Reported only for subgroup II; empty for subgroups I and III, where the source does not provide it.

age.Description: Age of the participant in whole years, derived by MNE-BIDS from the recording date and a birthday reconstructed as (recording date - reported age). Because of this round-trip it can be one year lower than the reported 'age_det'. 'n/a' where the source age is unknown.

hand.Description: Handedness of the participant. 'n/a' as handedness was not reported in the source.

weight.Description: Body weight of the participant. 'n/a' as weight was not reported in the source.

height.Description: Body height of the participant. 'n/a' as height was not reported in the source.
